title: The Documents section
summary: The project section that holds every document and its revisions.
roles: Any project role

title: New document…: list, plot, uploaded or datasheet document
summary: Make a document in the Documents section by choosing its kind.
roles: A project role that may write documents

title: List documents from a saved query, with PDF and Excel
summary: A list document shows a saved query from a starting point and prints it to PDF and Excel with a title block.
roles: A project role that may write documents; export needs a role that may export

title: Uploaded documents: revise a PDF from outside
summary: Keep a PDF made elsewhere as a document: attach it, then create a revision, which holds the newest attached PDF.
roles: A project role that may write documents

title: Versions and revisions of a document
summary: A document’s window shows its versions and revisions with the Document control card; Create revision… with a purpose of issue gives the next label.
roles: A project role that may create revisions (a Reviewer reads but creates none)

title: Statuses of a version or revision
summary: In sign-off, Rendering…, Could not make the PDF, Issued, Superseded, Rejected, Withdrawn and Deleted: where a version or revision is in its life.
roles: Anyone who may view the document

title: The Updated mark on Documents
summary: The Documents row shows Updated when a colleague added a revision since you last looked.
roles: Any project role

title: Issue a revision
summary: The last sign-off signature issues a revision: its PDF is made once, filed, and never changes; the revision before is superseded. While the revision gate is on, an open error on what the document shows refuses the revision when it is created.
roles: The person who signs the last step (Issue revisions)

title: Versions of a 2D space
summary: Create version… on a 2D space’s page makes an internal version (C.1 after Rev B): signed as prepared, issued at once, printed INTERNAL — NOT FOR ISSUE, seen only by people who see versions.
roles: A project role that may create versions (Engineer and above)

title: Revisions of a 2D space
summary: Create revision… on a 2D space’s page: the 2D space gets its document number and its printed area on its first output, and each revision goes through sign-off to an issued, filed PDF with its revision block.
roles: A project role that may create revisions (Engineer and above)

title: Sign-off: Prepared, Checked, Approved
summary: Every revision is signed by who prepared it, checked by someone else and approved by someone with Issue revisions; each signature asks you to confirm it is you. Reject… and Withdraw… take it back.
roles: Checked: Sign revisions (Engineer and above); Approved: Issue revisions (Lead engineer and above); never a Reviewer, a token or Alex

title: Delete and restore a version or revision
summary: Delete… with a reason takes a version or revision and its PDF out of the document; a record of who, when and why stays, its label is never used again, and Restore brings it back for the project’s kept period.
roles: Delete versions (Lead engineer and above); Delete revisions (project administrator)

title: Project settings → Documents
summary: The project’s revision scheme, document number pattern, purposes of issue, who sees versions, how long deleted outputs are kept, four-eyes and the output format.
roles: Configure documents (Lead engineer and project administrator)

title: Changes since a date on the drawing
summary: Changes since… on a 2D space draws a cloud around everything added, deleted, modified or moved since a day, a revision or a version, with before → after and who changed it.
roles: Anyone who may view the 2D space

title: Clouds and the changes table in a revision's PDF
summary: A version or revision is compared with the output before it: its PDF clouds what changed with a triangle carrying its label and lists each change beside the title block; Compare with… lists the changes between any two outputs.
roles: Anyone who may view the document; versions for people who see them

title: The sheet frame on the drawing
summary: A 2D space with a version or revision shows its sheet template's frame, title block and revision block in grey at its printed area and scale; Layers ▸ Sheet frame hides it.
roles: Anyone who may view the 2D space

title: Changed since Rev A, and Modified and Added marks
summary: After an issue, the document lists what changed since, and the explorer marks each changed object.
roles: Any project role

training.topic: What changed since the last issue

title: PDF of a P&ID 2D space
summary: Export PDF on a 2D space's page plots the 2D space to a vector PDF with a border and a title block.
roles: A project role that may export

title: Print… and Ctrl+P
summary: Print the open 2D space with File → Print… or Ctrl+P (⌘P).
roles: A project role that may export

title: Plot documents: 2D space, page format and layers
summary: A plot document prints a 2D space on a chosen page format with chosen layers, and has revisions.
roles: A project role that may write documents; output needs a role that may export

title: Open an object's datasheet
summary: Open an object's datasheet, the screen its values are viewed and edited on and that prints: the object window's Data sheet tab, or right-click a symbol → Open datasheet.
roles: Any project role (also read-only users)

title: Edit values on the datasheet
summary: Type values straight into the datasheet; units are added and checked, and Undo takes a change back.
roles: A project role that may edit objects

title: Datasheet PDF
summary: Export PDF on the datasheet writes the layout's fields, section by section, to a PDF.
roles: A project role that may export

title: Datasheet documents
summary: A datasheet document puts an object's datasheet under revision control.
roles: A project role that may write documents

title: The hookup schedule (PDF and Excel)
summary: One document in Revisions that lists every hookup with the instruments that use it and the material they need: exported as a PDF with a page per hookup, or as Excel, and revised and issued like any document.
roles: A project role that may create documents; exporting needs the permission to export the project

training.topic: The hookup schedule as a deliverable

title: The datasheet designer
summary: Copy or create a datasheet layout, add fields, preview it with an object, and publish it for a class.
roles: Datasheet design on the project

title: Filter documents by kind
summary: The All ▾ filter on the Documents page is meant to show only drawings, lists or datasheets.
roles: Any project role

title: Specification datasheets
summary: A datasheet of numbered lines, tables of parts that continue on continuation pages, operating cases and revision marks, the same on screen and in the PDF.
roles: Datasheet design on the project

title: Add row and Remove row on a datasheet
summary: Add and remove the parts a datasheet lists (nozzles, stages, sides) right on the datasheet.
roles: Any project role; editing values needs a role that may edit objects

title: Operating cases on the datasheet
summary: A case table shows the object’s cases side by side: inherited values, a case’s own values, Reset and + Add case.
roles: Any project role; editing values needs a role that may edit objects

title: Revision marks on a datasheet
summary: After a datasheet document is issued, each value changed since shows the next revision beside it.
roles: Any project role; editing values needs a role that may edit objects

title: Datasheet templates inspired by ISA 20 and API
summary: Ready-made specification datasheets for instruments (inspired by ISA 20) and for pumps and exchangers (inspired by API and ASME).
roles: Any project role; editing values needs a role that may edit objects

title: Design a specification datasheet
summary: Build a layout from components, make it apply only to some objects, preview several objects, and take over changes from the layout it was copied from.
roles: Datasheet design on the project
